description: RSS feed settings for a Total CMS collection. Used as a card sub-schema on the collection meta.
formgrid:
enabled .
name language
link image
description description
include exclude
limit hidden
---
title date
content author
media .

id.label: ID
id.help: Reserved — required by the schema system but unused for cards.

enabled.label: Publish RSS Feed
enabled.help: Serve this collection as an RSS feed at /feed/rss/{collection}. When disabled, that URL returns 404.

name.label: Feed Name
name.help: The feed's title in a reader. Defaults to the site name.

language.label: Language
language.help: The language the feed is written in.

description.label: Feed Description
description.help: A short description of the feed. Defaults to the feed name.

link.label: Link to Website
link.help: The page the feed belongs to. Defaults to the site's homepage.

image.label: Feed Image
image.help: URL of an image that represents the feed.

include.label: Include Filter
include.help: Only include objects matching this filter expression. Example: featured:true

exclude.label: Exclude Filter
exclude.help: Skip objects matching this filter expression. Example: category:internal

limit.label: Item Limit
limit.help: The most items the feed lists, newest first. Enter -1 for no limit.

hidden.label: Hidden Field
hidden.help: Objects with this property turned on are left out of the feed. Defaults to draft. Choosing another property replaces draft, so drafts are then included unless you exclude them. The property must be in the schema's index.

title.label: Title Property
title.help: Object property used for each item's title.

date.label: Date Property
date.help: Object property used for each item's date, and to sort the feed newest first.

content.label: Content Property
content.help: Object property used for each item's text. A Markdown field is rendered to HTML. The feed reads the collection index, so the property must be indexed.

author.label: Author Property
author.help: Object property used for each item's author.

media.label: Media Property
media.help: Object property used for each item's enclosure (audio, video or image).
